asterion03.title: The Patrol
asterion03.t01.man: A torch. Footsteps that don't know the way.
asterion03.d01: Monster? I... I just need one hair. One hair and I'm gone. I made a bet with the others.
asterion03.e01.hint: Reach your corner, far to the left, unseen. Move while the guard has his back to you; when the "?" appears he is about to turn: stand still inside one of the arches in the wall and no one can see you.
asterion03.e01.seen: Was seen by the guard's torch.
asterion03.dseen2: The young guard runs, trips, vanishes down the wrong gallery. Below, a thud.
asterion03.t02.man: My niche. No one touched it. But the torch went down an old gallery. And then, a thud.
asterion03.d02: The guard fell into the shallow well of the old galleries. He twisted his ankle. The torch is going out.
asterion03.d03: Vesta... Vesta, mother, I didn't mean... I just wanted them to stop laughing at me.
asterion03.h.tablet.1: A wax tablet fallen from his belt: the bet. Five guards' names and, below, "Quinto goes to fetch a hair from the monster". Someone drew a laughing bull.
asterion03.h.shard.1: A potsherd on the ground, near his hand. A closed eye scratched in a boy's hand. The College is already asking about this sign.
asterion03.c01: Quinto doesn't see him. The torch sputters, almost out.
asterion03.c01.help: Help: guide him to the way out without being seen.
asterion03.c01.easy: He smells of fear. It's easy.
asterion03.c01.attack: Attack, before he climbs up and tells what he saw.
asterion03.eguide.hint: Walk ahead of him and punch the wall (E): the guard limps toward the sound. Keep going right, to the stairs. If you turn and go at him, he drops in fear: punch the wall again to get him up.
asterion03.h.knock.2: The sound again. Further on. He follows, limping.
asterion03.h.knock.3: Air... I can feel air. The stairs!
asterion03.dhelp: Knock by knock, Quinto follows the sound. On the stairs, he stops and looks back into the dark. He sees nothing. But he knows.
asterion03.dleave: Asterion goes back into the dark. At dawn, Quinto finds the way out alone, hurt. And he tells everything he saw. Including what he found on the ground.
asterion03.dleave_plain: Asterion goes back into the dark. At dawn, Quinto finds the way out alone, hurt. He says the monster exists. No one quite believes him. Yet.
asterion03.mhold.hint: The beast wants the blow. Breathe.
asterion03.mhold.held: Held the blow a palm's width from the guard's face.
asterion03.dheld: The blow stops a palm's width from his face. Quinto flees screaming, limping, to the stairs. Tomorrow the College will know the monster exists.
asterion03.dlost: The shadow on the wall is bigger than the two of them. Then, only one.
asterion03.talive.man: His torch climbs the stairs, far away. Grows small. Gone.
asterion03.tshelter.man: The night will be cold. Where to sleep?
asterion03.eshelter.hint: To the left, under the Temple, the stone still keeps a little warmth. To the right, the deep, far from men.
asterion03.eshelter.warm: Went to shelter near the warmth, under the Temple.
asterion03.eshelter.deep: Went to shelter in the deep, far from men.
asterion03.twarm.man: Up there it's warm. It reminds me of the voice through the crack.
asterion03.tdeep.man: Deep. Far from men. Far from the warmth.
asterion03.tknown.man: That smell. Bread and shame. It's the guard from the grate, the one with the bread.
asterion03.cshard: The shard with Mirto's eye lies beside the guard's hand. If Quinto takes it upstairs, the College will have the sign and the boy who scratched it.
asterion03.cshard.take: Take the shard, this close to his fear.
asterion03.cshard.leave: Leave the shard where it is.
asterion03.tshard.man: The hand closes over the shard. This close to the guard's fear, something in me licks its teeth.
asterion03.dwounded: The shadow on the wall raises its arm. And stops halfway. Something in his smell, bread and shame, holds the blow at half. Quinto flees dragging his leg, bleeding. Alive.
asterion03.twounded.man: Half. I stopped at half. He will remember the other half forever.
